title: The Man Who Ate An Airplane, S3 THE X-RAY (line 5, rows 19-22, frames 519-638), DRAFT

film.kind: the signature X-ray film: a tiny Cessna built of square bites inside the belly

acts.note: row 19 "x -RAYED": hand on the clip bar, the box flickers, he leans in
row 19 "and": pushes the half-moon glasses down his nose
row 19 "found": a jolt back, he sees the tiny plane
row 20 "stomach": eyes wide as the camera goes into the film
the camera is inside the film from here (he is behind the lens); row 23 (next stretch) brings him back on the double take

fx.note: row 19 "-rayed": a glint runs over the tiny Cessna on the film
row 21 THICK: the lining glows as it puffs
row 22: oil sparkle behind the sliding plane

moods.note: row 20: the cut into the X-ray world rides a cyan-blue wash
row 21 POWER 2 cyan-white flash on THICK

stations.subject: doctor
stations.purpose: ROW 19 "x -RAYED" (ACT + SIGNATURE, M00 living rest then M02 push in): the doctor in 3/4 at the left leaning in to the glowing film, his hand on the clip bar; the film with the tiny bite-Cessna big at the right; the box flickers twice

stations.subject: doctor
stations.purpose: ROW 19 "found a" (push in over the doctor's shoulder): the film fills most of the frame, the Cessna of square bites and F-MIAM readable, his glasses and clip hand at the left edge

stations.subject: film
stations.purpose: ROW 20 "STOMACH" (M07 fly into the object): the film fills the lens, the cut into the X-ray world sits on the film grain

stations.subject: lining
stations.purpose: ROW 20 "STOMACH lining" (IMPOSSIBLE VIEW, M07 continued, eased): we come out of the film into the cartoon X-ray world: cyan ribs and spine as bands on mid-blue, the bean stomach, the tiny Cessna parked at the top of the lining

stations.subject: lining
stations.purpose: ROW 21 "so THICK" (POWER 2 + EXTREME 1, M02 push in to land): the lining PUFFS into a quilted mattress with runway dashes, cyan-white flash, then steady glow

stations.subject: mini
stations.purpose: ROW 22 "SLID" (SIGNATURE peak, M14 ride with the moving thing): the bite-Cessna at the lens, navy stripe, propeller humming, it starts down the runway

stations.subject: mini
stations.purpose: ROW 22 "through" (M14 ride, the camera rides with it): the plane slides along the oily lining, the sparkle trail behind it; the ride continues into the next stretch
